scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Zed Certification
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Should be a new manufacturing/service unit or an existing manufacturing/service unit undertaking expansion/diversification in the MSME sector
Unit must have commenced commercial production between 20.05.2022 and 19.05.2027
Applicant must apply within one year from the date of issue of the ZED certification
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy up to ₹1,00,000, after deducting any assistance received from the Government of India for ZED Certification
